column2: Inspect the existing task-decomposition data model and identify where a node stores its children.
Inspect the existing task-decomposition recursion and record how depth limits are represented.
Inspect the existing atomicity check and record the observable completion contract for leaves.
Inspect the existing Links Notation rendering and record how child relationships are serialized.
Inspect the existing recursive execution adapter and record how a decomposition tree is executed.
Inspect the existing task-strategy ledger and record how approved decomposition strategies are selected.
Write a minimal example of a two-child task decomposition with independently checkable leaves.
Verify that a leaf without an observable completion contract is never treated as independently checkable.
Inspect the binary decomposition invariant and explain the exactly-two-children requirement.
Verify the invariant explicitly names the supported power-of-two levels through 32.
Add or verify regression coverage for a two-node decomposition at depth one.
Add or verify regression coverage for a four-node decomposition at depth two.
Add or verify regression coverage for an eight-node decomposition at depth three.
Add or verify regression coverage for a sixteen-node decomposition at depth four.
Add or verify regression coverage for a thirty-two-node decomposition at depth five.
Verify every tested internal node has exactly two children and never three or more.
Verify every tested leaf is atomic and independently checkable.
Verify every tested node has a stable id and a unique dotted path.
Verify child paths follow the binary 1/2 convention at every depth.
Verify the node count of a complete depth-five tree is exactly 63 including the root.
Inspect the Agent-CLI ladder workflow and verify depth selection supports 0 through 5 and all.
Verify a single node can be selected by dotted binary path for focused debugging.
Verify the ladder can execute the 32 smallest leaves before moving to larger composite nodes.
Verify the ladder order for all mode is 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, then the root.
Verify every selected node runs in a fresh temporary repository copy.
Verify every selected node uses the real Agent CLI against the real Formal AI server.
Verify every selected node requires an observable proof file with its exact node path.
Inspect the committed binary-tree case-study and verify it describes a tree rather than a flat list.
Verify the case-study lists exactly 32 distinct atomic leaf formulations.
Verify the case-study path structure contains every binary path from depth one through five.
Use a differently worded decomposition request to check that the capability is not phrase-specific.
Produce a final evidence note containing the selected tree level, node outcomes, test results, and session id.
